correctness.rationale: Each off-cycle rooted tree contributes at least one leaf, and branching contributes more, proving the graph identification. Initial connectedness and two white directions require a cycle interval of size at least two and permit a nonempty tail prefix only when it includes the hub in its cycle interval. If the hub is omitted, force along both sides of the unseeded arc and color the hub last on the cycle; otherwise use a nonhub cycle boundary. Finish the tail. There are q of the c proper q-intervals containing the hub. The convolution-difference calculation gives a positive difference k-b_(k-t) through k=c-2, and nonpositive -b_(k-t) thereafter. The c=3,4 and t=1 positive cases check directly; the first internal determinant 4-c is negative in the complementary region. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/review_checks.py 5; 55 graphs of order <=13, 147417 nonempty masks per pass, via hitting every minimal fort and testing induced connectivity; arithmetic checks on 840 cases with 3<=c<=30, 1<=t<=30.
